name: Haha no Omanko ni Mosaic o Kakeru Boku ~Okaa-san wa Shakkin Dorei~
original_name: 母のオマンコにモザイクを掛ける僕～お母さんは借金奴隷～
source:
"If you can't pay back the money, maybe your wife will pay you with her body?"

Yuuki Kamimura and her mother, Yumiko, were living a modest life in a shabby apartment. Since his father's company went bankrupt, Yumiko earns money by working part-time, and Yuki attends school while working part-time.

His mother is kind, strong, and takes good care of him. Even though they were a little poor, Yuki was satisfied with his life. Until a man named Tatsuya came to visit him.

Nanba, an illegal moneylender, had come to collect his father's debt. In addition to the principal amount of 3 million, Nanba demanded a huge interest rate. Yumiko has no way to repay the debt, so Nanba makes a proposal.

We sell pornographic videos that we can't show in public. How about having your wife act as an adult film star in the video? Yumiko accepts the proposal for the sake of her family. Yuuki is shocked to hear that her mother is a porn star.

Nanba makes a further proposal to Yuuki. Nanba suggests to Yuki that he should edit his mother's pornographic videos.

[From [url=https://www.pin-point.biz/39_hhmz/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
“既然还不上钱，不如让你老婆拿身体来还？”

上村祐树和母亲由美子住在一间破旧公寓里，过着俭朴的日子。自从父亲的公司破产，由美子就靠打工挣钱，祐树则一边上学一边兼职。

母亲温柔、坚强，把他照顾得很好。日子虽穷，祐树却很知足。直到一个名叫龙也的男人找上门来。

放高利贷的难波龙也是来讨他父亲欠下的债的。除了三百万本金，他还索要高额利息。由美子根本无力偿还，于是难波提了个条件。

他们私下贩售见不得光的色情影片，不如让由美子来担任女优？为了家人，由美子答应了。听说母亲要拍色情片，祐树大为震惊。

随后，难波又向祐树提出了另一桩交易：让他负责剪辑自己母亲出演的那些影片。
